subject: Warmstart capacity safety net & product clarifications for Helix Health launch
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@helixhealth.com>, ops@helixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Warmstart capacity safety net & product clarifications for Helix Health launch

Team —

Helix is targeting a phased warmstart next month and just shared an updated hourly traffic forecast (attached). They expect a controlled ramp with two big bursts: an initial pilot at T0 and then a larger ingress at T+48h once the marketing banner hits.

Asks: 
- Can we provision a temporary quota uplift for the first 72 hours (target: 2x peak expected QPS) with an automatic step-down to baseline after T+72h?
- Product question: does prefix/KV cache populate quickly enough to avoid cold-start latency for their short-lived sessions? If not, what warmup hooks exist?
- Risk/backstop: what fallback model(s) can we route to if the primary model hits capacity constraints?

I’ve attached the forecast (helix_traffic_forecast_v2.xlsx) and a draft warmstart playbook. I need a short internal decision and a proposed rollout plan by EOD Monday so we can confirm with Helix.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Accounts Lead, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0132
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@helixhealth.com>, ops@helixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Warmstart capacity safety net & product clarifications for Helix Health launch

Eve —

Got it. Quick clarifying Qs so I can map infra actions:
- What is the expected peak sustained QPS and the 95th percentile token per request? (I’ll need numbers to size the uplift and pre-warm KV).
- Do they plan a geo-cutover or single-region traffic?

Proposed backstop while we stand up a quota uplift: temporary soft-throttles at 95% of the uplifted QPS with automated routing to a smaller, lower-cost model (compatible architecture) when latency breaches 800ms for >30s. I can draft the throttling policy and metric alerts this afternoon.

Attaching a short template I use for burst proposals — will populate when we have their peak numbers.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Warmstart capacity safety net & product clarifications for Helix Health launch

Numbers from product/serving team (preliminary):
- Expected peak (per Helix forecast): 420 QPS at T+48h (95th tokens/request = 210 tokens).
- Warmup behavior: prefix KV cache currently populates on first few requests; we do not have an out-of-band cache pre-seed for customer KV today. Product asks: can we add a temporary KV seeding hook for reserved capacity customers (Helix for this pilot)? That would reduce initial 95th latency by ~20–30%.

Recommendation:
1) Approve a 2x temporary quota uplift cap (840 QPS) for T0 → T+72h with step-down automation to their committed baseline at T+72h.
2) Priyom: pre-create the soft-throttle policy (95% of uplift), alerting (p50/p95 latency, error rate), and a routing rule to fallback-model-small if latency > 800ms for 30s.
3) Launch a short product task to seed KV (manual pre-seed) for the first 6 hours of the large ingress window. We’ll document the manual step in the warmstart_playbook.pdf.

I’ve attached a short warmstart checklist and the initial SLA carveout draft (sla-carveout-draft.docx).

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Operations
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@helixhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@helixhealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Warmstart capacity safety net & product clarifications for Helix Health launch

Thanks, Evelyn & team —

Confirming Helix’s ask: we will run pilot T0 (3 hours) on Dec 28 then open the broader campaign at T+48h (Dec 30). Peak estimates are conservative but we want safety. We request the 2x uplift for the first 48 hours of the campaign and the ability to extend by 24 hours if we observe retention > 60% after T+24h.

We appreciate the suggested backstop routing and the manual KV pre-seed option — Helix is fine with the manual step as long as we provide a runbook and a single point-of-contact during the window.

Sarah Thompson
Head of Platform Operations, Helix Health
sarah.thompson@helixhealth.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@helixhealth.com>, ops@helixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Warmstart capacity safety net & product clarifications for Helix Health launch — Decision + Next steps

Summary & decisions:
- Approve temporary quota uplift: 2x baseline (cap at 840 QPS) for Dec 28 T0 → Dec 30 23:59 PST (48h). Auto-step to baseline at 72h unless Helix requests extension and we approve.
- Operational backstops: Priyom to implement soft-throttle at 95% of uplift + automated routing to fallback-model-small on latency >800ms for 30s. Priyom to add escalation policy (pager + Slack huddle).
- Product action: Kimberly & team will perform manual KV pre-seed for the first 6 hours of the big ingress window; warmstart_playbook.pdf will include runbook and SRE contact.
- Commercial: Eve to send an updated carveout (sla-carveout-draft.docx) and confirm the billing treatment for the uplift window (we will log overage events and discuss crediting if we fail to meet latency targets).

Links & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bHelixLaunchForecast (forecast + playbook) | HubSpot:HS-D-92734
Attachments: helix_traffic_forecast_v2.xlsx, warmstart_playbook.pdf, sla-carveout-draft.docx

I’ll run the preflight checklist with Priyom on Dec 22. Please add any missing items to the Drive folder and tag the AP team for billing clarifications.

Thanks —
David Kim
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
